reviewed_scope: Nintendo-family additions found by comparing the existing SQLite/docs catalog with maintainer repositories and their READMEs: Nintendo 64, GameCube, Wii, Wii U, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, and Nintendo DS. External game assets/ROMs were not copied.
